in_arabic.name: لائق
in_arabic.meaning: لائق شخص جو اچھے اخلاق کا حامل ہو

in_pashto.name: لايق
in_pashto.meaning: د ښه او وړ شخص نوم
in_pashto.long_meaning: لايق د يو ښه او وړ شخص نوم دى. دا نوم د افغان او پښتون دودیزو کړو وړ شخص لپاره کارول کېږي. دغه نوم د چا لپاره چې خپلو کارونو او مسؤلیتونو لپاره مناسب وي، استعمال وي.

in_english.long_meaning: Laaiq is an Arabic-originated name meaning 'competent,' 'suitable,' or 'worthy.' It refers to someone who is qualified or fit for a particular task or responsibility. Although not directly mentioned in the Quran, the name Laaiq holds significance in Islamic tradition for its positive connotations. It symbolizes a person with good character and moral integrity.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Laaiq" represents someone who gathers or collects. In the Islamic context, this name can bring to mind the significance of collecting knowledge, experiences, and good deeds in this life for the hereafter. It can also symbolize the preservation and accumulation of Islamic history, art, literature, and tradition.
data.spiritual_significance: On a deeper level, the name "Laaiq" can inspire one to be a diligent and persistent collector of virtues, seeking to fill their heart with good qualities and righteous actions. It can serve as a reminder of the Prophet Muhammad's sayings, "Worthy of respect is the seeker of knowledge," and "The best of you are those who learn the Quran and teach it." By striving to acquire knowledge, wisdom, and good deeds, the name "Laaiq" can encourage individuals to make a positive impact on their own lives and the lives of others through acts of learning, teaching, and collecting.
